_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Batch S8 (Thule). Sourced 2026-07-05. Thule Urban Glide 2 (single). Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Thule Urban Glide 2

clekListed.clekRow: Thule Urban Glide 2 — Thule Urban Glide car seat adapter for Maxi-Cosi (20110740)

specs._unfoldedNote: Open dimensions per Strollberry's Urban Glide 2 (single) spec: 104.5 cm L x 69 cm W x 101.6 cm H = 41.1 x 27.2 x 40 in. Thule's own current page no longer lists them (model superseded by UG3).

brake.type: twist-action hand/running brake plus foot-operated parking brake

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: 6 mo+ for jogging; birth with infant car seat via adapter or Thule bassinet

specs._capacityNote: Max child ~48.5 lb (22 kg); total load (child + storage) rated 75 lb. Basket weight limit not clearly published for UG2 → null.

safety.standards: Meets US ASTM F833 stroller standard — Clek's list confirms the UG2 was tested with the Liing and is ASTM-compliant for car seats on strollers.
safety.notes: 5-point harness; twist hand brake for speed control on descents; wrist safety strap.

specs.recline: multi-position recline to near-flat, one-hand adjust
specs.tires: pneumatic air-filled rubber; large 16 in rear wheels, smaller swivel/lockable front wheel

notes: The Urban Glide 2 is the prior-generation jogger, now superseded by the Urban Glide 3 / 4-Wheel; largely sold through as drop-ship/limited stock (Jen's Organic Baby lists $749.95 as store-pickup/drop-ship). A capable running stroller (~25 lb) but not the light/compact city goal — closest analog to the owned BOB Alterrain Pro. Clek Liing attaches via the Urban Glide Maxi-Cosi adapter 20110740 (adapter-20110740), itself largely discontinued. Open dimensions and basket limit not published for this superseded single → null + notes.
